items.title: Noomi Rapace Launches Production Company Boom Films, Dedicated to Female-Driven Projects and Backed by Thomas Benski’s Lumina Media (EXCLUSIVE)
items.title_zh: 努米·拉帕斯成立制作公司Boom Films，专注于女性主导的项目，并得到托马斯·本斯基的Lumina Media支持（独家）
items.summary: Noomi Rapace is venturing into the film and TV production space by officially launching Boom Films, co-founded with her longtime manager and production partner Stella Härnström.
items.summary_zh: 努米·拉帕斯（Noomi Rapace）正式成立了Boom Films，进军影视制作领域。该公司由她与长期经纪人兼制片合作伙伴斯特拉·哈恩斯特伦（Stella Härnström）共同创立。

items.title: Treasury yields fall as investors await key inflation signal
items.title_zh: 投资者等待关键通胀信号，国债收益率走低
items.summary: Bond yields moved lower Wednesday as investors awaited key inflation and spending data during a holiday-shortened week.
items.summary_zh: 周三，债券收益率走低，原因是投资者正等待本周因假期而缩短的交易周内即将公布的关键通胀和支出数据。

items.title: Two children among six dead in plane crash
items.title_zh: 坠机事故造成6人死亡，其中有2名儿童
items.summary: Divers have found the bodies of six people, including two children, after a plane crashed off the coast of Mississippi on Tuesday, according to the US Coast Guard.
items.summary_zh: 据美国海岸警卫队称，周二一架飞机在密西西比州海岸坠毁后，潜水员发现了六具尸体，其中包括两名儿童。

items.title: AI debt worries grow as Nvidia rebound masks Big Tech spending squeeze
items.title_zh: 随着英伟达股价反弹掩盖了大型科技公司的支出压力，人工智能领域的债务担忧日益加剧
items.summary: Big Tech could find it increasingly tough to secure funding from debt markets critical to the AI build-out, as lenders become pickier over corporate bonds.
items.summary_zh: 随着贷款人对公司债券变得更加挑剔，大型科技公司可能会发现越来越难以从对人工智能发展至关重要的债务市场获得融资。

items.title: Lionsgate Play Casts AI Actor Yug R.Ai in Series ‘Eklavya,’ Partners With Google Cloud (EXCLUSIVE)
items.title_zh: Lionsgate Play为剧集《Eklavya》选定AI演员Yug R.Ai，并与Google Cloud合作（独家）
items.summary: Streaming platform Lionsgate Play has cast an AI performer, Yug R.Ai, as the lead of “Eklavya,” a mythological series that is the platform’s first AI-led original.
items.summary_zh: 流媒体平台Lionsgate Play已选定AI演员Yug R.Ai担任神话剧《Eklavya》的男主角，该剧是该平台首部由AI主演的原创剧集。

items.title: Crypto talent will return ‘when AI implodes,’ Arthur Hayes says
items.title_zh: Arthur Hayes表示，当人工智能“内爆”时，加密人才将回归
items.summary: Maelstrom CIO Arthur Hayes expects the AI trade to face headwinds in the second half of 2027, with startup talent potentially returning to crypto afterward.
items.summary_zh: Maelstrom首席信息官Arthur Hayes预计，人工智能交易将在2027年下半年遭遇阻力，此后初创企业人才可能会重返加密货币领域。

items.title: Donald Trump set to raise tariffs on 16 major economies
items.title_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普计划对16个主要经济体提高关税
items.summary: Donald Trump is set to raise tariffs on China, the European Union and several other countries, according to reports.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，唐纳德·特朗普计划对中国、欧盟和另外几个国家提高关税。

items.title: US financial crimes bureau discloses ‘cybersecurity incident’
items.title_zh: 美国金融犯罪局披露“网络安全事件”
items.summary: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) disclosed on Tuesday that it's investigating a "cybersecurity incident." The bureau, which is part of the Treasury Department, said it's looking into an "incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its…
items.summary_zh: 金融犯罪执法网（FinCEN）周二披露，该机构正在调查一起“网络安全事件”。该局隶属于美国财政部，表示正在调查一起“导致未经授权访问其……有限子集的事件”。

items.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
items.title_zh: 耶鲁大学的索嫩菲尔德：英伟达对美国工业实力“有害”——而非捍卫者
items.summary: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the…
items.summary_zh: 耶鲁大学的杰弗里·索南菲尔德（Jeffrey Sonnenfeld）警告称，市场周一欢呼的黄仁勋在白宫支持下重返英伟达担任首席执行官和董事会成员一事，可能会被证明是一个巨大的错误，使董事们因日益增多的诉讼而面临“历史性”的个人责任，并提高了……

items.title: Trump reportedly says pardoning Jensen Huang is ‘an option’
items.title_zh: 据报道，特朗普表示赦免黄仁勋“是一个选项”
items.summary: Huang faces ongoing questions about his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive with alleged ties to Chinese intelligence who previously worked for a company that has been accused of illegally diverting Nvidia chips to China.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋正面临着对其与Alice Huang关系的持续质疑，后者是一位据称与中国情报部门有联系的高管，此前曾就职于一家被指控非法将Nvidia芯片转运至中国的公司。
